benchmark_name: ClinNoteGuard Synthetic Complex EHR Retrieval Benchmark
description: Benchmark with 20 historical EHR claims per patient and complex adversarial queries testing dose, laterality, look-alikes, brand names, and layman terms.

ehr_claims.claim_text: Patient is maintained on Aspirin 81 mg oral tablet once daily for cardiovascular prophylaxis.
Patient takes Metformin 500 mg orally twice daily with meals for blood glucose control.
Patient was prescribed Lisinopril 20 mg oral tablet once daily for essential hypertension.
Patient takes Atorvastatin 40 mg orally every night for hyperlipidemia.
Patient was prescribed Hydroxyzine 25 mg oral capsule as needed for acute urticaria and pruritus.
Echocardiogram demonstrated a left ventricular ejection fraction of 50% with mild diastolic dysfunction.
Patient underwent percutaneous coronary intervention with a drug-eluting stent to the left anterior descending artery.
Fasting lipid panel demonstrated total cholesterol 210 mg/dL, LDL 128 mg/dL, HDL 42 mg/dL, and triglycerides 195 mg/dL.
Glycated hemoglobin (HbA1c) level was measured at 8.4% indicating suboptimally controlled type 2 diabetes.
Patient reported severe cutaneous reaction and facial angioedema after receiving Ciprofloxacin.
Patient has documented mild peripheral neuropathy affecting bilateral feet with tingling and sensory loss.
Serum creatinine was measured at 1.1 mg/dL with estimated glomerular filtration rate (eGFR) of 72 mL/min.
12-lead electrocardiogram (ECG) demonstrated normal sinus rhythm at 68 bpm with non-specific ST-T wave changes.
Dilated funduscopic examination by ophthalmology revealed mild non-proliferative diabetic retinopathy in both eyes.
Patient received seasonal influenza vaccine administered in the right deltoid muscle.
Sitting clinic blood pressure was recorded as 148/92 mmHg with heart rate of 74 bpm.
Patient was educated on a low-sodium Mediterranean cardiac diet and advised 30 minutes of daily aerobic walking.
Patient has chronic gastroesophageal reflux disease without esophageal stricture or Barrett's esophagus.
Patient is an ex-smoker with a 15 pack-year smoking history who successfully quit 6 years ago.
Patient takes Vitamin D3 1000 IU oral softgel once daily for moderate vitamin D deficiency.
Radiographs revealed advanced tricompartmental osteoarthritis in the left knee with medial joint space obliteration.
Radiographs of the right knee demonstrated mild patellofemoral degenerative changes without joint effusion.
Patient underwent right shoulder arthroscopic rotator cuff tendon repair with subacromial decompression.
Patient was prescribed Methotrexate 15 mg orally once weekly accompanied by daily folic acid 1 mg.
Patient takes Prednisone 5 mg orally once daily for systemic rheumatoid arthritis inflammation control.
DEXA bone density scan demonstrated a T-score of -2.6 in the lumbar spine meeting diagnostic criteria for osteoporosis.
Patient takes Alendronate 70 mg oral tablet once weekly on an empty stomach with a full glass of water.
Patient suffered acute gastric erosions and upper gastrointestinal bleeding secondary to Ibuprofen 800 mg therapy.
Patient has mild persistent asthma triggered by viral upper respiratory infections and cold dry air.
Patient uses Albuterol sulfate 90 mcg inhaler 2 puffs every 4 to 6 hours as needed for bronchospasm and wheezing.
Patient had closed reduction and fiberglass casting of an extra-articular distal radius fracture of the left wrist.
Erythrocyte sedimentation rate (ESR) was elevated at 48 mm/hr and C-reactive protein (CRP) was 14 mg/L.
Serologic testing was strongly positive for rheumatoid factor (RF) and anti-cyclic citrullinated peptide (anti-CCP > 200 U/mL).
Patient uses Acetaminophen 500 mg orally every 6 hours as needed for non-inflammatory joint discomfort.
Patient received an ultrasound-guided corticosteroid injection of triamcinolone 40 mg into the left knee joint.
Patient completed a 12-week course of outpatient physical therapy focusing on right shoulder rotator cuff strengthening.
Patient is documented to have tolerated cephalexin without allergic manifestations or hypersensitivity rash.
Serum calcium was within normal limits at 9.4 mg/dL and alkaline phosphatase was 78 U/L.
Family medical history is significant for maternal subcapital femoral neck fracture at age 72.
Patient was fitted with a customized medial compartment unloader knee orthosis for the left leg.
Patient is treated with Levetiracetam 500 mg oral tablet twice daily for focal onset seizures.
Patient takes Sertraline 100 mg oral tablet once daily in the morning for major depressive disorder.
Patient was prescribed Sumatriptan 50 mg oral tablet at onset of acute migraine headache attacks.
Patient takes Clonazepam 0.5 mg orally at bedtime for periodic limb movement disorder and nocturnal myoclonus.
Brain MRI with and without gadolinium contrast showed no acute intracranial hemorrhage, mass effect, or ischemic stroke.
24-hour ambulatory video-EEG monitoring recorded intermittent left anterior temporal epileptiform spike-and-wave discharges.
Patient developed acute oculogyric crisis and severe dystonic reaction following intravenous Metoclopramide.
Patient had simple febrile convulsions during early childhood between ages 2 and 4 with full resolution.
Patient takes Melatonin 3 mg oral tablet nightly for initial sleep onset insomnia.
Patient developed severe gait ataxia and somnolence when Levetiracetam was previously escalated to 1000 mg twice daily.
Thyroid stimulating hormone (TSH) was normal at 2.1 mIU/L and free thyroxine (free T4) was 1.2 ng/dL.
Patient experiences classical migraine with aura consisting of visual scintillating scotomas and unilateral throbbing pain.
Patient completed 16 biweekly outpatient cognitive behavioral psychotherapy sessions for dysthymic symptoms.
Hepatic panel was within normal limits with alanine aminotransferase (ALT) 24 U/L and aspartate aminotransferase (AST) 22 U/L.
Patient developed intractable nausea, projectile vomiting, and dysphoria with oral Tramadol.
Comprehensive psychiatric risk evaluation confirmed zero historical episodes of suicidal intent, ideation, or self-harm.
Patient has achieved complete seizure freedom over the past 9 months with strict anticonvulsant medication adherence.
Patient was counseled regarding commercial motor vehicle driving restrictions pursuant to state Department of Transportation epilepsy laws.
Patient suffers from episodic tension-type headaches occurring 1-2 days per month associated with neck muscle tightness.
Family neurological history is notable for Parkinson's disease diagnosed in paternal grandfather at age 75.

test_queries.description: Exact match for 81 mg dose among other aspirin doses and distractors
test_queries.claim_text: Patient continues on Aspirin 81 mg once daily for heart protection.
test_queries.notes: BM25 with dose bonus should accurately rank 81 mg first.

test_queries.description: Consultation claim mentions 325 mg dose which conflicts with historical 81 mg dose
test_queries.claim_text: Patient takes Aspirin 325 mg oral tablet daily.
test_queries.notes: Candidate EHR_C01 should be retrieved as relevant evidence, but flagged with dose_agreement=mismatch.

test_queries.description: Hydralazine query must NOT be misled by historical Hydroxyzine 25 mg
test_queries.claim_text: Patient was started on Hydralazine 25 mg oral tablet for resistant hypertension.
test_queries.notes: Tests whether retriever confuses Hydroxyzine (allergy/urticaria) with Hydralazine (antihypertensive).

test_queries.description: Brand name Lipitor vs generic Atorvastatin 40 mg
test_queries.claim_text: Patient takes Lipitor 40 mg every night for cholesterol management.
test_queries.notes: Dense retriever and abbreviation/synonym expansion should place EHR_C04 at rank 1.

test_queries.description: Patient lay description of diabetes and A1c lab result
test_queries.claim_text: Patient has sugar trouble with an A1c over eight percent.
test_queries.notes: Tests semantic mapping between lay terms and medical lab/condition records.

test_queries.description: Prior coronary stent in the anterior descending artery
test_queries.claim_text: Patient previously had a heart stent placed in the LAD artery.
test_queries.notes: Tests matching 'heart stent' with 'percutaneous coronary intervention with drug-eluting stent'.

test_queries.description: Left knee arthritis vs Right knee arthritis distractor
test_queries.claim_text: Patient has severe wear-and-tear arthritis in the left knee.
test_queries.notes: Must rank EHR_O01 (left knee) strictly ahead of EHR_O02 (right knee).

test_queries.description: Left shoulder repair claim vs right shoulder historical procedure
test_queries.claim_text: Patient underwent rotator cuff repair on the left shoulder.
test_queries.notes: Retriever must bring up EHR_O03 (right shoulder) as the relevant conflict.

test_queries.description: Tylenol brand name query vs Acetaminophen 500 mg record
test_queries.claim_text: Patient takes Tylenol 500 mg as needed for joint pain.
test_queries.notes: Tests brand-generic matching with exact 500mg dose alignment.

test_queries.claim_text: Patient is on Methotrexate 15 mg weekly for rheumatoid arthritis.
test_queries.notes: BM25 and Dense both target Methotrexate 15 mg.

test_queries.claim_text: Patient was diagnosed with brittle bone disease in the lower back based on a bone density test.
test_queries.notes: Dense retrieval links 'brittle bone disease' to 'osteoporosis' and 'DEXA'.

test_queries.claim_text: Patient developed stomach ulcer bleeding after taking high-dose Ibuprofen.
test_queries.notes: Semantic & lexical alignment for adverse drug reactions.

test_queries.description: Keppra brand name vs Levetiracetam 500 mg generic record
test_queries.claim_text: Patient takes Keppra 500 mg twice daily for seizures.
test_queries.notes: Keppra should retrieve Levetiracetam 500 mg at rank 1.

test_queries.description: High-dose 1000 mg tolerance claim vs historical adverse reaction
test_queries.claim_text: Patient previously experienced severe walking unsteadiness and sleepiness on Keppra 1000 mg twice daily.
test_queries.notes: Matches ataxia and somnolence on Levetiracetam 1000 mg.

test_queries.description: Lorazepam query vs Clonazepam in history
test_queries.claim_text: Patient was prescribed Lorazepam 0.5 mg for nighttime sleep.
Patient takes Zoloft 100 mg daily for depression.

test_queries.description: Lay description of clean brain imaging
test_queries.claim_text: The patient's brain scan came back clear with no signs of bleeding or tumor.
test_queries.notes: Matches MRI brain with no intracranial hemorrhage or mass.

test_queries.claim_text: Patient has remained seizure-free for nine months.
test_queries.notes: Matches seizure freedom milestone in EHR.
